static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2) on the (2,45000,50000) descriptor, whose 30-pointer family is word-identical to the 6ch record of the same build: every statically hosted array (envelope ladder, remap curve offsets and both remap extensions) is byte-verified from the paired build. The ATH, octave, mask and interval surfaces have no static host anywhere in the paired build (exhaustive full-array byte search); instruction-level evidence shows they are per-frame adaptive state driven by the streamed source PCM, not init-time materializations. Their current registered values are frequency-mapped operating-point approximations of that mechanism and are labeled provisional, pending the builder/mechanism re-derivation. Per-field classification in corpus/paired-build/the round/artifacts/replacement-diff-table.json; provenance ledger in corpus/paired-build/the round/.

static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2): band-limit rows and blend weights are byte-verified against the paired build's channel-family tables; the per-mode candidate trio, curve caps and the 3x128 mask-curve surfaces are per-frame adaptive state (no static host; streamed-audio-driven, per the r10 provenance evidence), and their current values are frequency-mapped operating-point approximations labeled provisional pending mechanism re-derivation.

1024-bin curves, interval and profile words, seed curves, group labels and tone surfaces have no static host in the paired build and are per-frame adaptive state (streamed-audio-driven); current values are operating-point approximations (some shared bitwise with the 6ch registration via descriptor-pointer identity, some frequency-mapped) and are labeled provisional pending mechanism re-derivation.

the long-mode 2/3 analysis surfaces have no static host in the paired build and are per-frame adaptive state; current values are operating-point approximations (frequency-mapped from the 6ch registration) labeled provisional pending mechanism re-derivation.
